description: Flatten script hierarchy in BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx so Roblox Studio auto-runs Scripts and LocalScripts. Remove intermediate 'Server' and 'Client' folders that prevented auto-execution.
steps: Remove 'Server' folder from ServerScriptService in BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx, move Script 'Main' and Folder 'Services' to be direct children
Remove 'Client' folder from StarterPlayerScripts in BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx, move LocalScript 'Main' and all ModuleScript controllers to be direct children
Update default.project.json to point to flattened src paths
Move src files from Server/ and Client/ subdirectories to their parent directories
Validate CDATA sections preserved (17 total) and XML well-formedness
Validate structure matches requirements via Python XML parser
acceptance_criteria: Script 'Main' is a direct child of ServerScriptService (no intermediate folder)
Folder 'Services' is a direct child of ServerScriptService (sibling of Main)
LocalScript 'Main' is a direct child of StarterPlayerScripts (no intermediate folder)
ModuleScript 'UIController' is a direct child of StarterPlayerScripts
ModuleScript 'PetController' is a direct child of StarterPlayerScripts
ModuleScript 'CampaignController' is a direct child of StarterPlayerScripts
ModuleScript 'EffectsController' is a direct child of StarterPlayerScripts
All 17 CDATA script source blocks preserved
Require paths in Lua scripts still valid (script.Parent.Services.X and script.Parent:WaitForChild(Y))
verification: python3 -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; ET.parse('BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx'); print('Valid')"
Python XML parser confirms Script 'Main' is direct child of ServerScriptService
Python XML parser confirms no Folder 'Server' or Folder 'Client' in hierarchy
findings: Roblox Studio does not auto-run Scripts placed inside sub-Folders of ServerScriptService or StarterPlayerScripts. Used text-based XML manipulation (tools/fix_hierarchy.py) to preserve CDATA sections that xml.etree.ElementTree would strip. De-indented child elements by one tab level when removing wrapper folders. Require paths in Main.server.lua and Main.client.lua were already correct for the flat structure (script.Parent references the containing service, and siblings are accessed via script.Parent.Services.X or script.Parent:WaitForChild('X')).
